blockingIssues.description: Resolver applies agent profile model overrides even when agents.allow_agent_model_overrides is false, diverging from runtime policy behavior.
Section-level inheritance tracking can remain stale because precedence only upgrades and does not downgrade after fallback replacement.
Rollback snapshots are sourced from redacted /api/admin/config payloads; restoring them can erase secret/token values instead of restoring true prior state.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/architecture.md to document runtime model-override gating via agents.allow_agent_model_overrides and to document that GET /api/admin/config is redacted and unsafe for rollback snapshots.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Align Step 5 validator guidance with mission-level known pre-existing Playwright failures by allowing scoped e2e specs when full-suite failures are unrelated to the assigned feature.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: agent-contract-ui review observed predictable skill-procedure deviation because SKILL.md requires full Playwright suite while mission AGENTS.md explicitly instructs scoped specs for in-progress migration features.
